faqs.question: What are your office hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We also offer Saturday appointments from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes! We accept most major dental insurance plans including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, and MetLife. We also offer payment plans for uninsured patients.

faqs.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can call us at (555) 123-4567 or book online through our website. We typically have availability within 1-2 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency appointments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer same-day emergency care for severe toothaches, broken teeth, or dental trauma. Call us immediately at (555) 123-4567.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.answer: Please bring your photo ID, insurance card, and any recent dental X-rays. Arrive 15 minutes early to complete paperwork.

faqs.question: Is the parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have free parking in our lot behind the building. There's also street parking available on Main Street.

faqs.question: Do you see children?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We welcome patients of all ages, including children. We make kid visits fun and comfortable.

policies: Cancellation Policy: Please give 24-hour notice for cancellations. Late cancellations may incur a $50 fee.
Payment: Full payment is due at time of service unless prior arrangements are made.
Insurance: We file insurance claims as a courtesy to our patients.
